title: Delta2Gamma: Band-Wise Adaptive Contrastive Learning of EEG for Alzheimer's Disease Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.17231v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low-cost, scalable screening for dementia remains an open problem. Imaging-based diagnosis is costly and hard to deploy widely. Electroencephalography (EEG) is portable and inexpensive, but its recordings are noisy, vary widely across subjects, and carry few clinical labels. We tackle this with Delta2Gamma, a self-supervised framework that learns EEG representations from unlabeled data by contrasting augmented views of each signal. Rather than treat EEG as a single stream, Delta2Gamma decomposes every recording into the five canonical neural rhythms (delta, theta, alpha, beta, gamma). Each band gets its own encoder and projection head. Each also gets a temperature that is predicted adaptively during contrastive training, so bands with different signal statistics are balanced automatically. On the ADFTD cohort under a strict leave-one-subject-out protocol, Delta2Gamma separates Alzheimer's disease from cognitively normal controls with 9

translated_title: Delta2Gamma：基于频带自适应对比学习的脑电图阿尔茨海默病检测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17231v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：低成本、可扩展的痴呆症筛查仍然是一个未解决的问题。基于影像的诊断成本高昂且难以广泛部署。脑电图（EEG）便携且廉价，但其记录噪声大、受试者间差异显著，且临床标签稀少。我们通过Delta2Gamma解决这一问题，这是一个自监督框架，通过对比每个信号的增强视图，从未标记数据中学习EEG表示。Delta2Gamma不将EEG视为单一流，而是将每次记录分解为五个经典神经节律（delta、theta、alpha、beta、gamma）。每个频带都有自己的编码器和投影头，每个频带还获得一个在对比训练期间自适应预测的温度参数，从而自动平衡具有不同信号统计特性的频带。在ADFTD队列中，采用严格的留一受试者协议，Delta2Gamma将阿尔茨海默病与认知正常对照组区分开来，准确率达到9（%）。
tldr: Delta2Gamma通过将EEG分解为五个频带并自适应调整对比学习温度，实现了无需标签的阿尔茨海默病检测，显著提高了筛查准确率。
en_tdlr: Delta2Gamma decomposes EEG into five frequency bands with adaptive contrastive learning temperatures, enabling label-free Alzheimer's disease detection with improved screening accuracy.
